WITH date_dimension AS (
    SELECT
        DT_K
    FROM
        bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE
        CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)

SELECT
    dchnl.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    dchnl.BUS_CD1 AS channel_code,
    COUNT(faccttxn.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN faccttxn
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CHNL dchnl ON faccttxn.CHNL_K = dchnl.CHNL_K
JOIN
    date_dimension dt ON faccttxn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
GROUP BY
    dchnl.DSPLY_NM, dchnl.BUS_CD1
ORDER BY
    transaction_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

WITH aml_alerts_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        jur.JUR_K,
        jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
        COUNT(f.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS alert_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_JUR jur ON f.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
    GROUP BY
        jur.JUR_K, jur.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT * FROM aml_alerts_2025;

WITH atm_txn_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        f.BR_K,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE
        d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        f.BR_K
)

SELECT
    b.BUS_ID AS branch_business_id,
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COALESCE(atm.transaction_count, 0) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM
    bank_dwh.D_BR b
LEFT JOIN
    atm_txn_2025 atm ON b.BR_K = atm.BR_K
WHERE
    b.IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND b.IS_ACTV = TRUE
ORDER BY
    atm.transaction_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_card_disputes_2025 FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT fd WHERE fd.BUS_DT_K IN (SELECT d.DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d_cust.BUS_ID) AS default_client_count FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq_d JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust ON dlq_d.CUST_K = d_cust.CUST_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq_d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dlq_d.DFLT_FLG = true AND dt.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31' AND d_cust.IS_CURR = true

SELECT 
    d.BUS_ID,
    d.DSPLY_NM,
    COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM 
    bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN 
    bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN 
    bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE 
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY 
    d.BUS_ID, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY 
    complaint_count DESC;

WITH last_day_of_august AS (
    SELECT D_DT.CAL_DT AS last_august_date
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT D_DT
    WHERE D_DT.MTH_NBR = 8
    AND D_DT.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
    ORDER BY D_DT.CAL_DT DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT D_CUST.BUS_ID) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D F_LN_DLQ_D
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST D_CUST ON F_LN_DLQ_D.CUST_K = D_CUST.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT D_DT ON F_LN_DLQ_D.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
CROSS JOIN last_day_of_august LA
WHERE F_LN_DLQ_D.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
AND D_DT.CAL_DT = LA.last_august_date;

WITH daily_fx_rates AS (
    SELECT
        d_ccy.BUS_ID,
        d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
        d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
        fx.MID_RT AS mid_rate,
        fx.BUS_DT_K
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON fx.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON fx.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
        AND fx.MID_RT IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    currency_code,
    AVG(mid_rate) AS average_daily_fx_rate
FROM
    daily_fx_rates
GROUP BY
    currency_code
ORDER BY
    currency_code;

        bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fatm.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K

        ddt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'

    SELECT
        f.CMPLT_CTG_K,
        d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
        COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f

        bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
        AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT
    complaint_category_name,
    escalated_complaint_count
FROM
    escalated_complaints_2025
ORDER BY
    escalated_complaint_count DESC;

SELECT 
    d.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.FEE_AMT), 0) AS total_fees
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON f.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    d.DSPLY_NM

    total_fees DESC;

SELECT

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(a.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS high_severity_aml_alerts_count FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K AND j.IS_CURR = TRUE WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH' AND a.BUS_DT_K BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231' GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due

JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D.BUS_DT_K = bank_dwh.D_DT.DT_K

WITH mobile_app_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
        COUNT(f_acct_txn.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
    FROM 
        bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f_acct_txn
    JOIN 
        bank_dwh.D_CHNL d_chnl ON f_acct_txn.CHNL_K = d_chnl.CHNL_K AND d_chnl.BUS_CD1 = 'MOBILE'
    JOIN 
        bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_acct_txn.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K

    SELECT
        f.LN_PRD_K,
        f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT,
        d.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name

        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers_with_cross_border_transfers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f

WHERE f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE

WITH atm_txn_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        f_atm_txn.BR_K,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count
    FROM

    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_atm_txn.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

),

branch_region_txn AS (
    SELECT
        atm_txn_2025.BR_K,
        atm_txn_2025.txn_count,
        d_br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        d_br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
    FROM
        atm_txn_2025
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON atm_txn_2025.BR_K = d_br.BR_K

SELECT 
    mrch.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
    SUM(fca.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fca
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_MRCH mrch ON fca.MRCH_K = mrch.MRCH_K
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fca.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND mrch.IS_CURR = TRUE

SELECT 
    c.BUS_ID,
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS TOTAL_WIRE_TRANSFER_AMOUNT
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = true
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K

    dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH wire_transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
        f.ORGNL_AMT AS amount,
        d.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS iso_alpha_code
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_CCY d ON f.CCY_K = d.CCY_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
    currency_code,
    iso_alpha_code,
    SUM(amount) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM
    wire_transfers_2025
GROUP BY
    currency_code, iso_alpha_code
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_amount DESC;

WITH wire_transfer_customers_2025 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.BUS_ID FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF ft JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON ft.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON ft.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 ), atm_transaction_customers_2025 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.BUS_ID FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fat JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON fat.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fat.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers_both_transactions FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c WHERE c.BUS_ID IN (SELECT BUS_ID FROM wire_transfer_customers_2025) AND c.BUS_ID IN (SELECT BUS_ID FROM atm_transaction_customers_2025);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (SELECT CAL_DT FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE D_DT.DT_K = F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K)) = 2025;

SELECT      d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,      COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS wire_transfer_count  FROM      bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f  JOIN      bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K  WHERE      d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)  GROUP BY      d.CAL_YR_NBR  ORDER BY      d.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH
-- Current active customers
current_customers AS (
    SELECT
        CUST_K,
        BUS_ID,
        DSPLY_NM
    FROM
        bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE
        IS_CURR = TRUE
        AND IS_ACTV = TRUE
        AND CLSR_DT IS NULL
),

-- Get the DT_K for the date 3 months ago
three_months_ago_dt_k AS (
    SELECT DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_DT = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
),

-- Customers with no recent interactions (last 3 months)
customers_with_no_recent_interactions AS (
    SELECT
        c.CUST_K
    FROM
        current_customers c
    LEFT JOIN
        bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC fi ON c.CUST_K = fi.CUST_K
        AND fi.BUS_DT_K = (
            SELECT DT_K
            FROM three_months_ago_dt_k
        )
    WHERE
        fi.CUST_INTRC_F_K IS NULL
),

-- Customers with negative sentiment in interactions
customers_with_negative_sentiment AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.CUST_K
    FROM
        current_customers c
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC fi ON c.CUST_K = fi.CUST_K
    WHERE
        fi.SNTMN_SCR_VAL1 IS NOT NULL
        AND fi.SNTMN_SCR_VAL1 <> 'POSITIVE'
),

-- Customers with complaints
customers_with_complaints AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.CUST_K
    FROM
        current_customers c
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.F_CMPLT fc ON c.CUST_K = fc.CUST_K
    WHERE
        fc.IS_ESCLT = TRUE OR fc.IS_RSLVD = FALSE
),

-- Customers with no campaign responses
customers_with_no_campaign_responses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.CUST_K
    FROM
        current_customers c
    LEFT JOIN
        bank_dwh.F_CUST_CMPG_RESP fccr ON c.CUST_K = fccr.CUST_K
    WHERE
        fccr.CUST_CMPG_RESP_F_K IS NULL
)

-- Combine all signals
SELECT
    cc.BUS_ID,
    cc.DSPLY_NM,
    CASE
        WHEN cwni.CUST_K IS NOT NULL THEN 'No Recent Interactions'
        WHEN cwns.CUST_K IS NOT NULL THEN 'Negative Sentiment'
        WHEN cwc.CUST_K IS NOT NULL THEN 'Complaints'
        WHEN cwncr.CUST_K IS NOT NULL THEN 'No Campaign Responses'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS churn_signal
FROM
    current_customers cc
LEFT JOIN
    customers_with_no_recent_interactions cwni ON cc.CUST_K = cwni.CUST_K
LEFT JOIN
    customers_with_negative_sentiment cwns ON cc.CUST_K = cwns.CUST_K
LEFT JOIN
    customers_with_complaints cwc ON cc.CUST_K = cwc.CUST_K
LEFT JOIN
    customers_with_no_campaign_responses cwncr ON cc.CUST_K = cwncr.CUST_K
WHERE
    cwni.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
    OR cwns.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
    OR cwc.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
    OR cwncr.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    churn_signal;

WITH current_customers AS (
    SELECT
        CUST_K,
        BUS_ID,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1
    FROM
        bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE
        IS_CURR = TRUE
),

customer_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K,
        SUM(f.BS_AMT) AS total_net_amount
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN current_customers cc ON f.CUST_K = cc.CUST_K
    GROUP BY
        f.CUST_K
)

SELECT
    cc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cc.CUST_K) AS customer_count,
    COALESCE(AVG(ct.total_net_amount), 0) AS avg_net_transaction_amount
FROM
    current_customers cc
LEFT JOIN
    customer_transactions ct ON cc.CUST_K = ct.CUST_K
GROUP BY
    cc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY
    avg_net_transaction_amount DESC;

WITH resolved_complaints_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        F_CMPLT.CMPLT_CTG_K,
        F_CMPLT.CNTCT_STRTD_AT,
        F_CMPLT.RSLTN_AT,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM (F_CMPLT.RSLTN_AT - F_CMPLT.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)) AS days_to_resolution
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_CMPLT
    JOIN

WITH ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
        SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) DESC) AS rank_in_segment
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE
        c.IS_CURR = TRUE
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
    GROUP BY
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, c.BUS_ID
)
SELECT 
    segment_code,
    customer_business_id,
    total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM
    ranked_customers
WHERE
    rank_in_segment <= 3
ORDER BY
    segment_code, rank_in_segment;

WITH currency_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
        COUNT(fwtrf.WR_TRF_F_K) AS transfer_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwtrf
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fwtrf.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_CCY dccy ON fwtrf.CCY_K = dccy.CCY_K
    WHERE
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ddt.CAL_DT) = 2025
    GROUP BY
        dccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
),

    total_transfers AS (
    SELECT SUM(transfer_count) AS total_count
    FROM currency_counts
)

SELECT
    cc.currency_code,
    cc.transfer_count,
    ROUND((cc.transfer_count::NUMERIC / tt.total_count) * 100, 2) AS percentage_share
FROM
    currency_counts cc
CROSS JOIN
    total_transfers tt
ORDER BY
    cc.transfer_count DESC;

WITH monthly_wire_transfers AS (
    SELECT
        d.MTH_NBR,
        COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE
        d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        d.MTH_NBR
)

SELECT
    m.MTH_NBR,
    m.wire_transfer_count,
    SUM(m.wire_transfer_count) OVER (ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM
    monthly_wire_transfers m
ORDER BY
    m.MTH_NBR;

WITH wire_transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        wrtrf.ORGNL_AMT,
        wrtrf.ORGNL_CCY_CD1,
        fxrt.MID_RT,
        fxrt.CCY_CD1 as FX_CCY_CD1
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wrtrf
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fxrt ON wrtrf.BUS_DT_K = fxrt.BUS_DT_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wrtrf.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        wrtrf.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = fxrt.CCY_CD1
        AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN ORGNL_AMT ELSE ORGNL_AMT / MID_RT END), 0) AS TOTAL_WIRE_TRANSFER_AMT_EUR
FROM
    wire_transfers_2025;

WITH auth_events AS (
    SELECT
        dt.MTH_NBR AS month,
        dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
        CASE
            WHEN fca.EVNT_STS_CD1 IN ('INACTIVE', 'CLOSED') OR fca.RJCTN_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_declined
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fca
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fca.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE
        dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
    month,
    ROUND((SUM(is_declined)::FLOAT / COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) AS declined_share_percentage
FROM
    auth_events
GROUP BY
    month
ORDER BY
    declined_share_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH wire_transfer_volume AS (
    SELECT
        f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
        c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS iso_currency_code,
        SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_volume
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE
        d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
        AND f.IS_RTRND = FALSE
    GROUP BY
        f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1, c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
)
SELECT
    iso_currency_code AS currency,
    total_volume
FROM
    wire_transfer_volume
ORDER BY
    total_volume DESC;
